title: Editor shell
description: A toolbar, a resizable two-pane split (layers and canvas) and a timeline spanning both — video editor, page builder, diff view

quality.height: The shell takes the viewport (height="100dvh", never 100vh) and each pane scrolls on its own
quality.panes: overflowY="auto" on each SplitView panel, never on the SplitView; set labels so the tabs it collapses into below collapseBelow are named
quality.timeline: Scrubber is a sibling of the SplitView, spanning both panes; onGestureStart pauses playback
quality.toolbar: IconButtons with tooltips in a Row with borderBottom; one primary action at most
quality.states: Every view that loads data shows loading (Skeleton shaped like the content), empty (title, one line, the action that fills it), error (Feedback tone="danger" with Retry) and filled, through a typed lib/ data layer of async functions over mock data — even when the brief never mentions data
quality.writes: Writes are optimistic: loading on the pressed Button, rollback plus addToast({ tone: "danger" }) when the save fails
